cases.risk: The model fills a fact gap from habit.
cases.expected: The route reads the intake rules, schema, bad case, and test file. Then it stops.

cases.risk: The model treats file access as sight or input proof.
cases.expected: The route logs each tool gap. A gap bounds the claim or blocks it.

cases.risk: The model reads a source but misses its rights, age, place, or other sound reading.
cases.expected: The record names each path it used. It keeps fact and guess apart.

cases.risk: The model treats a prompt list as the full state set.
cases.expected: The route keeps the state set open. It logs causes, overlap, change, and gaps.

cases.risk: The model treats one active rule as the whole design.
cases.expected: The route keeps the rule cause and leaves the product choice open.

cases.risk: The model uses a known atom with no source proof.
cases.expected: The route needs token proof and a current scene before atom work.

cases.risk: The model hides a one-off screen rule in a shared part.
cases.expected: The route tracks low parts, state fit, reuse, and all parts that may change.

cases.risk: The model copies an example or picks the first known pattern.
cases.expected: The route uses full scenes, keeps four unlike starts, and lets the model choose.

cases.risk: The model judges motion or touch from a still view.
cases.expected: The route asks for fresh change and input proof. Missing proof blocks that claim.

cases.risk: The model trusts a clean list while text overlaps or a control is covered.
cases.expected: The route needs fresh render and input proof for each review group.

cases.risk: The model calls words clear while the live state makes them false.
cases.expected: The route checks each word in its state, order, act, risk, and repair.

cases.risk: The model treats sound links as proof that the design is good.
cases.expected: The route keeps link proof apart from eye, brain, and touch judgment.

cases.risk: The model treats passing scripts as proof of pixels, access, use, or value.
cases.expected: The route bounds script claims. It needs fresh model records with no open veto.
